name: 波点蕾丝丝带滑雪套装（咖色）
description:
奶白底咖色小波点的滑雪套装：外套 + 雪裤。袖子和裤腿两侧缀满咖色丝带和蕾丝，胸前一圈荷叶边，复古又甜美的运动少女风。

## 面料与科技
- 防水防风滑雪面料，带保暖填充
- 可调防风帽子，高领设计，鱼骨帽檐保暖又挺括

## 设计细节
- 两侧丝带和蕾丝装饰，胸前荷叶边显比例
- 复古小波点
- 腰部三段可调防雪裙，内置腰部调节带
- 腋下透气系统
- 3D 立体弹力防雪袖口，裤脚防滑防雪套
- 内置雪镜口袋，加长拉链拉绳，戴手套也好拉
- 只能手洗，不可漂白、熨烫，不用柔顺剂，阴凉处晾干
descriptionEn:
A cream snow suit with tiny brown polka dots: jacket + pants. Brown ribbons and lace run down the sleeves and legs, with a ruffle across the chest — a sweet, vintage take on sporty style.

## Fabric & Tech
- Waterproof, windproof ski fabric with insulation
- Adjustable windproof hood with a high collar and structured boned brim

## Design Details
- Ribbon and lace trims on the sides; chest ruffle that flatters your proportions
- Dainty vintage polka dots
- 3-stage adjustable powder skirt and internal waist adjusters
- Underarm ventilation
- 3D-cut elastic snow cuffs and non-slip leg gaiters
- Inner goggle pocket and extended zipper pulls for gloved hands
- Hand wash only; no bleach, ironing or fabric softener; hang dry in the shade

name: 浅蓝格子雪裤
description:
浅蓝色法式格纹雪裤，裤腿有抽绳褶皱设计，还配一只可拆卸的小熊挂件，复古又可爱。版型宽松，单板、双板都适合。

## 面料与科技
- Teflon™ 三防面料：防风、防水、防油污
- 防水指数 20000mmH₂O，接缝 ≥20mm 宽压胶
- 耐磨 >60000 次
- 20D 经编内衬 + 高分子防水膜
- 适合 -30℃ 到 -20℃

## 设计细节
- 法式格纹（Vichy），复古运动风
- 裤腿抽绳褶皱，轻盈有层次
- 腰部三段可调防雪裙，内置腰带
- 可拆卸小熊挂件
- 加长拉链拉绳，戴手套也好拉
- 裤脚防雪套
- 只能手洗，不可漂白、熨烫，不用柔顺剂，阴凉处晾干
descriptionEn:
Baby-blue French gingham snow pants with drawstring ruching down the legs and a detachable teddy bear charm — vintage and cute. Relaxed fit, great for snowboarding or skiing.

## Fabric & Tech
- Teflon™ triple-defense fabric: wind, water and oil resistant
- Waterproof rating 20,000 mmH₂O with ≥20 mm seam tape
- Abrasion resistance >60,000 cycles
- 20D tricot lining with a high-molecular waterproof membrane
- Built for −30°C to −20°C

## Design Details
- Classic French gingham (Vichy) check
- Drawstring ruching on the legs for a light, textured look
- 3-stage adjustable powder skirt and built-in belt
- Detachable teddy bear charm
- Extended zipper pulls for gloved hands
- Leg gaiters to keep snow out
- Hand wash only; no bleach, ironing or fabric softener; hang dry in the shade

name: 巧克力冰淇淋滑雪套装（咖色）
description:
奶油白配巧克力色“融化冰淇淋”拼接的滑雪套装：外套 + 雪裤，像淋了巧克力酱的冰淇淋。精致刺绣和立体纹理，可爱又不花哨。

## 面料与科技
- 防水指数 20000mmH₂O
- 透湿量 20000+ g/m²·24h
- 耐磨 >60000 次
- 20D 经编加固层 + 纳米分子防水膜
- 适合 -20℃ 到 -10℃

## 设计细节
- 巧克力“滴落”拼接，精致刺绣和立体纹理
- 高领 + 可调帽子，挡风保暖
- 腰部固定防雪裙
- 袖口防雪口袋，随手放小东西
- 只能手洗，不可漂白、熨烫，不用柔顺剂，阴凉处晾干
descriptionEn:
A cream snow suit with chocolate “melting ice cream” color-blocking: jacket + pants, like a scoop dipped in chocolate sauce. Refined embroidery and 3D texture keep it playful without being loud.

## Fabric & Tech
- Waterproof rating 20,000 mmH₂O
- Breathability 20,000+ g/m²/24h
- Abrasion resistance >60,000 cycles
- 20D tricot reinforcement layer with a nano-molecular membrane
- Built for −20°C to −10°C

## Design Details
- Chocolate drip color-blocking with fine embroidery and 3D texture
- High collar and adjustable hood for wind protection

- Snow-proof cuff pocket for quick-access essentials

name: 米白蛋糕裙修身滑雪套装
description:
米白色修身滑雪套装：收腰高领外套 + 浅灰雪裤。外套下摆是层层叠叠的蛋糕裙，胸前点缀浅蓝色立体蝴蝶结，芭蕾风，又甜又显身材。适合双板。

## 面料与科技
- 杜邦 Teflon™ 三防面料：防风、防水、防油污
- 防水指数 20000mmH₂O，接缝 ≥20mm 宽压胶
- 透湿量 20000+ g/m²·24h
- 耐磨 >60000 次
- 20D 经编加固层 + 纳米分子防水膜
- 适合 -20℃ 到 -10℃

## 设计细节
- 层层蛋糕裙下摆，芭蕾风轮廓
- 高领收腰，显比例
- 立体蝴蝶结装饰
- 腰部三段可调防雪裙，内置腰部调节，裤脚防雪套
- 3D 立体弹力袖口，加长拉链拉绳，内侧隐藏口袋
- 只能手洗，不可漂白、熨烫，不用柔顺剂，阴凉处晾干
descriptionEn:
A slim cream ski suit: waist-cinching high-collar jacket + light gray pants. The jacket ends in a tiered ruffle “cake” skirt and has baby-blue 3D bows on the chest — ballet-inspired, sweet and flattering. Best for skiing.

## Fabric & Tech
